scripts.lint: web-ext lint --source-dir . --ignore-files tests scripts node_modules package.json package-lock.json
scripts.build: web-ext build --source-dir . --artifacts-dir web-ext-artifacts --overwrite-dest --ignore-files tests scripts node_modules package.json package-lock.json
scripts.sign: web-ext sign --source-dir . --artifacts-dir web-ext-artifacts --channel unlisted --ignore-files tests scripts node_modules package.json package-lock.json
